'''Bonne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], where he set up an equipment stall inside a [[Republic Supply Center]] built within the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]]. Bonne wore a [[Color/Legends|green]] uniform and a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] while in Quesh's toxic [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. He had fair skin, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown hair.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bonne appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Equipment Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Quesh. His location was also marked in ''The Old Republic's'' accompanying [[Prima Games]] strategy guide, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''. Bonne was later relabeled as Private Bonne and used as a Level 34 Modifications Vendor, and with the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], he now appears on a number of planets and [[Carrick Station]].
